question: List all song names by singers above the average age.
schema:
stadium(Stadium_ID, Location, Name, Capacity, Highest, Lowest, Average)
singer(Singer_ID, Name, Country, Song_Name, Song_release_year, Age, Is_male)
concert(concert_ID, concert_Name, Theme, Stadium_ID, Year)
singer_in_concert(concert_ID, Singer_ID)
expected_sql: SELECT song_name FROM singer WHERE age  >  (SELECT avg(age) FROM singer)
generated_Sql:
SELECT s.Name, s.Song_Name

FROM singer s

JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID

JOIN concert c ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID

WHERE s.Age > (SELECT AVG(Age) FROM singer);

question: What are all the song names by singers who are older than average?
schema:
stadium(Stadium_ID, Location, Name, Capacity, Highest, Lowest, Average)
singer(Singer_ID, Name, Country, Song_Name, Song_release_year, Age, Is_male)
concert(concert_ID, concert_Name, Theme, Stadium_ID, Year)
singer_in_concert(concert_ID, Singer_ID)
expected_sql: SELECT song_name FROM singer WHERE age  >  (SELECT avg(age) FROM singer)
generated_Sql:
SELECT s.Name, s.Song_Name

FROM singer s

JOIN (

    SELECT AVG(Age) AS AvgAge

    FROM singer

) AS avg_singer

ON s.Age > avg_singer.AvgAge

ORDER BY s.Name, s.Song_Name;
